purpose: Teach: 壁画/シビア/カーナビ/ハッピーエンド/ツイ/奏で/豪雨/南国

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、古代壁画と現代アート、対比、興味深いですね。
lines.en: Your paper on ancient murals versus modern art — that's a fascinating angle.
lines.style: Warm, measured tone. Leans slightly forward in genuine interest. Opens with a gentle acknowledgment, then shifts to curious observation. Not rushing to judgment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。シビアな評価、章末で添えました。
lines.en: Yes. I included some critical analysis toward the end of the paper.
lines.style: Steady, attentive voice. Not defensive about the critique — matter-of-fact. Eyes meeting hers briefly. Speaks with quiet confidence, no overexplaining.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 移動中の取材、カーナビ、活躍しましたか。
lines.en: Did the GPS help you while you were out doing research interviews?
lines.style: Natural follow-up question, warm curiosity. Slight tilt of head, genuinely wanting to know the practical details. Doesn't assume — asks to learn.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。物語、ハッピーエンドで終わる伝統、別章にしました。
lines.en: It did. I separated out the section on how different cultures approach happy endings into its own chapter.
lines.style: Speaking more openly now, a bit more comfortable. Voice steadies as he talks about his work. Unhurried, as if sharing something he's thought about carefully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: SNSのツイ、研究のヒントになりますね。
lines.en: Social media posts can really spark new directions in research, can't they?
lines.style: Reflective, conversational. Not rhetorical — genuinely thinking aloud. Warm acknowledgment of how modern research works. Slight pause before speaking, as if turning an idea over.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 演奏家が奏でる現代曲、論文の付録で紹介します。
lines.en: I'm including examples of contemporary compositions in the appendix — pieces that performers are actually playing now.
lines.style: More animated than before, quietly proud. Voice has subtle energy now when discussing something he finds worthwhile. Clear and direct without being rushed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 豪雨後の遺跡保全、緊急テーマでもあります。
lines.en: Protecting those sites after heavy rains is urgent too — that's worth addressing.
lines.style: Serious but not heavy. Voice has shifted to acknowledge real-world stakes. Thoughtful pause between clauses. This matters, and she's saying so plainly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 南国の文化的多様性、最終章でまとめました。
lines.en: I've woven the cultural diversity of tropical regions throughout the final chapter.
lines.style: Calm conclusion. Voice settles into resolution. Sense of integration and completeness. Speaks with quiet accomplishment without boasting — this is where it all comes together.
